Breakpoints.Advisor: Allocation Tab - Spaghetti/Counterfeit/Iron Pill to 0, Number to 1E+20; Adventure Tab - Do combat in ITOPOD (combat in a lower zone for gold prior to boss 30); Gold Tab - Turn on CBlock Mode
Breakpoints.Comment: Make sure to disable all beards and stat advancement, set targets on TM and Augments (6-10 Milk Infusion before TM, 10-20 Energy Cannon after TM)
Breakpoints.WandoosNotes: Wandoos does not help a ton, and just eats levels once TM is unlocked. WAN can be left off entirely for slightly slower, but more AFK progress. Always disable Wandoos allocation after 30 and save levels for TM/Energy Cannon/Big-Ass Hickey.
Breakpoints.TMNotes: At this point in the game energy speed FAR outpaces magic speed. 59/10 TM levels are optimal, but something like 50/2-4 is a much more likely balance. 50 speed will be obtained before 3m, 3 multiplier will take around 7m.

Energy.Comment: If WAN levels get to 90 prior to TM, remove WAN

Magic.Note: RIT-7 is the EIGHTH ritual and it only exists once the NORMAL Troll challenge has 6+ completions (ritualsUnlocked() returns a count, 7 or 8). CBlock2-Normal runs TC-5/6/7 and finishes before Evil entry, so the ritual is unlocked by the time this block starts; boss 105 is under the boss 125 this profile is entered at. If you skipped those Trolls the lane reports locked and is dropped before the share is divided - it costs nothing, it just does nothing.

Diggers.Comment: Wandoos + Stats + Adventure + MBeard + PP + Blood + Exp
